mapper.sql: SELECT tdm20_role_id AS role_id , tdm20_role_nm AS role_name , tdm20_role_type AS role_type , f_cdnm('TdmRoleType', tdm20_role_type, tdm20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS role_type_name , tdm20_role_type_etc_nm AS role_type_etc_name , tdm20_overview AS overview , (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN '' ELSE COUNT(*)||'건' END FROM tdm21_role_relate_task WHERE tdm21_role_id = tdm20_role_id) AS role_relate_task_cnt , (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN '' ELSE COUNT(*)||'건' END FROM tdm22_role_relate_cncl WHERE tdm22_role_id = tdm20_role_id) AS role_relate_cncl_cnt , (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN '' ELSE COUNT(*)||'건' END FROM tdm23_role_relate_org WHERE tdm23_role_id = tdm20_role_id) AS role_relate_org_cnt , tdm20_ceo_role_id AS ceo_role_id , (SELECT sub.tdm20_role_nm FROM tdm20_role sub WHERE sub.tdm20_role_id = a.tdm20_ceo_role_id) AS ceo_role_name , tdm20_start_date AS start_date , tdm20_end_date AS end_date , tdm20_upd_nm AS upd_name , COALESCE(TO_CHAR(tdm20_upd_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), ''::text) AS upd_date_str FROM tdm20_role a
mapper.select: SELECT tdm20_company_id FROM tdm20_role WHERE tdm20_role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm20_role ( tdm20_role_id, tdm20_company_id, tdm20_role_nm, tdm20_role_type, tdm20_role_type_etc_nm, tdm20_overview , tdm20_start_date, tdm20_end_date, tdm20_ceo_role_id, tdm20_upd_nm, tdm20_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{roleId}, #{companyId}, #{row.roleName}, #{row.roleType}, #{row.roleTypeEtcName}, #{row.overview} , #{row.startDate}, #{row.endDate}, #{row.ceoRoleId}, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
mapper.select: SELECT tdm21_role_relate_task_id AS role_relate_task_id , tdm21_role_id AS role_id , tdm21_task_id AS task_id , f_cdnm('TdmTaskClassCode', tdm10_task_class_cd, tdm10_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS task_class_name , tdm14_task_type_nm AS task_type_name , tdm10_task_nm AS task_name , tdm10_start_date AS start_date , tdm10_end_date AS end_date FROM tdm21_role_relate_task INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm21_role_id = tdm20_role_id INNER JOIN tdm10_task ON tdm21_task_id = tdm10_task_id INNER JOIN tdm14_task_type ON tdm10_company_id = tdm14_company_id AND tdm14_task_type_cd = tdm10_task_type_cd WHERE tdm21_role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT tdm10_company_id FROM tdm10_task WHERE tdm10_task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm21_role_relate_task ( tdm21_role_relate_task_id, tdm21_role_id, tdm21_task_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{roleId}, #{taskId} )
mapper.select: SELECT tdm22_role_relate_cncl_id AS role_relate_cncl_id , tdm22_role_id AS role_id , tdm22_cncl_id AS cncl_id , tdm05_cncl_nm AS cncl_name , tdm22_member_type AS member_type , f_cdnm('TdmCnclMemberType', tdm22_member_type, tdm05_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS member_type_name , tdm22_start_date AS start_date , tdm22_end_date AS end_date FROM tdm22_role_relate_cncl INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm22_role_id = tdm20_role_id INNER JOIN tdm05_cncl ON tdm22_cncl_id = tdm05_cncl_id WHERE tdm22_role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm22_role_relate_cncl ( tdm22_role_relate_cncl_id, tdm22_role_id, tdm22_cncl_id, tdm22_member_type, tdm22_start_date, tdm22_end_date ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{roleId}, #{row.cnclId}, #{row.memberType}, #{row.startDate}, #{row.endDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT tdm23_role_relate_org_id AS role_relate_org_id , tdm23_role_id AS role_id , tdm23_org_id AS org_id , org00_kor_nm AS org_name FROM tdm23_role_relate_org INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm23_role_id INNER JOIN getOrg(#{companyId}, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) ON org00_org_id = tdm23_org_id WHERE tdm23_role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY org00_org_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm23_role_relate_org ( tdm23_role_relate_org_id, tdm23_role_id, tdm23_org_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{roleId}, #{orgId} )
